visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in an indoor setting with warm, bright lighting where a pair of hands is seen unboxing merchandise. Two small figures, one in a white hoodie and another in a black jacket, are lifted from a black box. A large black tote bag with white circular text rests on a white bed surface. (2) The person continues showing items, including a white knit hat with a pom-pom and small printed cards. A dark gray t-shirt with a purple cat illustration playing a guitar is unfolded against a white backdrop. The hands are visible as they manipulate the soft fabric and paper items. (3) The scene shifts to the person wearing the merchandise in a room with wooden paneling and a bookshelf. The person models a light gray hoodie with red graffiti-style text on the back, then a dark gray zip-up hoodie, and finally a green bomber jacket with a large red abstract graphic. The camera movements are handheld and follow the person's motions.
